Running it
----------
simcity.cas is a cassette image for the Mitsubishi Multi 8: load it from
the tape drive (in an emulator, play the image).  The game runs in the
machine's 64 KB RAM mode.  Saving a city writes it to tape, and loading
one reads it back; press Esc to cancel a tape operation.

The game draws in the 640 x 200 colour mode, with the planes paged in
over $8000, and uses the PSG for sound effects.

To load from BASIC enter:

MON
R
GC000

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down (shifted capitals: eight)
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters, sound

If the letters stop working, the keyboard is in its GRAPH or KANA mode:
switch it back (in an emulator, the host's Alt, Kana and Caps Lock keys
change these).
